mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content_like WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId}::integer
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO content_like (member_id, target_type, target_id, reg_id, reg_dt, reg_ip) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}::integer, #{regId}, NOW(), #{regIp}) ON CONFLICT (member_id, target_type, target_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM content_like WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId}::integer
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET good_cnt = COALESCE(good_cnt, 0) + 1 WHERE post_id = #{targetId}::integer
UPDATE post SET good_cnt = GREATEST(0, COALESCE(good_cnt, 0) - 1) WHERE post_id = #{targetId}::integer
UPDATE comment SET good_cnt = COALESCE(good_cnt, 0) + 1 WHERE comment_id = #{targetId}::integer
UPDATE comment SET good_cnt = GREATEST(0, COALESCE(good_cnt, 0) - 1) WHERE comment_id = #{targetId}::integer
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post WHERE post_id = #{targetId}::integer AND use_yn = 'Y'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment WHERE comment_id = #{targetId}::integer AND use_yn = 'Y'
